import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

src=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))

def mask(poly, blur=0.0):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S))
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in poly],fill=255)

    return np.asarray(im.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255

def composite(base, rgb, alpha):

forepoly=[(140,19),(148,19),(150,27),(150,32),(147,38),(141,41),(135,38),(135.5,31),(136.8,25)]

# Bilinear sampling for premultiplied RGBA.
def bilinear(tex,x,y):

def rigid(tex, pivot, newpivot, angle):

    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H*S,:W*S].astype(float)

    valid=(ux>=0)&(uy>=0)&(ux<W-1)&(uy<H-1)

def centers(ys,frame):
    g=grasps[frame].copy()
    s=ys-48
    origx=np.interp(ys,sy_nodes,cx_nodes)-140
    if frame<=9:

        lag=[0,0,-1,-3,-6,-11,-14,-14,-13,-11][frame]
        x=g[0]+origx*(1-ease*.72)+lag*np.clip(s/59,0,1)**1.5
        y=g[1]+s

    blend=np.clip((s-free+3)/6,0,1)

    minx=max(0,int(np.floor(p[:,0].min())));maxx=min(W*S-1,int(np.ceil(p[:,0].max())))
    miny=max(0,int(np.floor(p[:,1].min())));maxy=min(H*S-1,int(np.ceil(p[:,1].max())))
    if maxx<minx or maxy<miny:return
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[miny:maxy+1,minx:maxx+1].astype(float);xx+=.5;yy+=.5
    a,b,c=p
    den=(b[1]-c[1])*(a[0]-c[0])+(c[0]-b[0])*(a[1]-c[1])
    if abs(den)<1e-6:return
    wa=((b[1]-c[1])*(xx-c[0])+(c[0]-b[0])*(yy-c[1]))/den
    wb=((c[1]-a[1])*(xx-c[0])+(a[0]-c[0])*(yy-c[1]))/den
    wc=1-wa-wb

    if not np.any(inside):return

    v=wa[inside]*uv[0][1]+wb[inside]*uv[1][1]+wc[inside]*uv[2][1]

    ys=np.unique(np.r_[np.arange(45.,110.,1.5),109.,sy_nodes])

    cx=np.interp(ys,sy_nodes,cx_nodes)
    left=ct-19*norm;right=ct+19*norm

    canvas=over(canvas,rigid(uppertex,root,root,a1))
    canvas=over(canvas,rigid(foretex,elbow0,el,a2))
    canvas=over(canvas,fabric(frame))
    # Wrist maintains the grasp orientation using its revolute joint.
    tool=rigid(handtex,wrist0,wrist,0.)
    if frame>=17:

        yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H*S,:W*S]

    print('Saved 20 RGB frames at 256x144, 4 fps.')
